map.额定电流=功率(kW)×1000÷(√3×电压×功率因数0.85)（三相）；建议: Rated current = power (kW) × 1000 ÷ (√3 × voltage × power factor 0.85) (three phase); recommended cable cross-section = round up(current ÷ 6) × 6 mm² (at 6A/mm² ampacity). Humid environments need IP54 or higher.

map.功率为 kW、公式用 W 须 ×1000；三相用 √3、功率因数常取 0.85: Power in kW but the formula uses W, hence ×1000; three-phase uses √3 and the power factor is typically 0.85
map.6A/mm² 为粗略载流量，实际随敷设方式、环境温度、并列根数变化: 6A/mm² is a rough ampacity; in reality it varies with installation method, ambient temperature and number of parallel runs
map.重要回路须查电缆载流量表并留余量: Important circuits need the cable ampacity table plus a margin
map.潮湿/腐蚀/防爆环境须提高防护等级（IP/防爆标志）: Humid, corrosive or explosion-proof environments require a higher protection level (IP / explosion-proof marking)
map.功率为 kW，公式用 W，故×1000；电压用 V、√3 为三相系数、0.85: Power is in kW while the formula uses W, so ×1000; voltage in V, √3 for three phases and 0.85 as a typical power factor, giving the line current (A).
map.为常见敷设条件下的粗略值，实际载流量随敷设方式、环境温度、并列根数大幅变化；重要: A rough value for common installation conditions; in reality ampacity varies widely with installation method, ambient temperature and number of parallel runs, so important circuits need the cable ampacity table plus a margin.
